snippet.title: The Cup - Highlights Trailer (Demo Out Now!)
snippet.description:
1v1 creature card battles, broadcast to the galaxy. Real animals from the US, Canada and Mexico, three a side, and the die TV decides how hard every hit lands.

The demo is out now on Steam. It has THE ROAD (five bouts against invasive species), the tutorial, and matches against the House, all offline. The Cup is free to play and the full release with live 1v1 on Steam, is November 10.

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5079520/The_Cup/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=episode&utm_campaign=sizzle-30

Card art by @chioart08, @prayogaardip, Ondřej Tichý and @tmcglynnart.

#thecup  #indiegame  #cardgame
